gen-gf-baumans-gf-cambay: Crescent-wrench curves, every stroke drawn to a single width. Cambay, a modern sans-serif whose rounds gap open like a cracked bangle, keeps the text quiet so Baumans can do the commanding.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-catamaran: Catamaran brings curvy, unclamped letters, an approachable sans sitting beneath Baumans and its toothpaste-squeezed line. Catamaran stays friendly down a long column, its loose curves never tiring the eye.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Commanding, Baumans looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, while Chiron Hei HK pulls its c apart. Loud vinyl punch over plain sans that stays out of its way.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-commissioner: Distinctive Baumans leads with a crescent-wrench c, then hands off to Commissioner, a sans-serif whose smooth curves never clog. Long paragraphs should glide along, with nothing to snag the eye.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-didact-gothic: Wrench-wide curves, all drawn at a single line width. Didact Gothic, a modern sans-serif with no closed-up bowls to snag on, gives Baumans a contemporary partner for the text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-dotgothic16: A crescent-wrench c, opened wide, gives Baumans its commanding look, with every stroke the same width. But DotGothic16, a sans-serif with wide channels into each counter, is the one built to carry quiet, approachable text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-doto: Ruler-and-compass crispness, right down to the crescent-wrench c. Doto, a modern sans with generous mouths on its rounds and wide margins around each glyph, gives Baumans room to command.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-el-messiri: Baumans has no thin strokes to vanish in glare, while El Messiri swells mildly like a worn felt marker. Paragraphs in this plain sans move along cleanly, the swell easing each line.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-electrolize: Electrolize, a modern plain sans, opens its c like a pair of pliers, jaws apart. And Baumans, with strokes that never pinch at the curves, supplies the commanding voice above it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-elms-sans: Baumans opens like a crescent wrench, wide and commanding. Elms Sans wins on plain clarity, with a ballpoint's pressure-free line and a gap you can see through in each s.
